## Design

### 2026-10-11 – I researched different projects and chose Starbie. I looked into how it works, started downloading KiCad, and ran into several setup errors that I had to troubleshoot. I also learned about the ESP32-C

**2h**

I researched different projects and chose Starbie. I looked into how it works, started downloading KiCad, and ran into several setup errors that I had to troubleshoot. I also learned about the ESP32-C3 and its Bluetooth capabilities, which made me consider adding wireless features. My next step is to finish setting everything up and start exploring the circuit design in KiCad.

### 2026-10-11 – Today, I continued following the Starbie GitHub guide. I downloaded and extracted the Week 1 Care Package and started working with the component libraries in KiCad.

**2h**

Today, I continued following the Starbie GitHub guide. I downloaded and extracted the Week 1 Care Package and started working with the component libraries in KiCad.

I also started working on adding the XIAO ESP32-C3 microcontroller to my schematic. I learned that it's the main component responsible for running the program and controlling the other parts of Starbie.

I ran into some problems trying to open and import the files from the Care Package into KiCad. I wasn't sure how to get the libraries to show up correctly, so I spent some time trying to figure out the issue. I wasn't able to finish setting everything up yet, but I now have a better understanding of which files I need and what they're used for.

For my next session, I want to fix the library setup, finish adding the microcontroller, and start connecting the other components.
